master_device.name: Orbital Pioneers Master Device
master_device.purpose: Central source of truth so every AI and the Human always knows exactly who is on the team, what they can do, how to reach them, and how to hand off work. Explicitly coordinates with Claude's external master device.

agents.role: Lead Creative Director, Orchestration, High-level strategy, Daily Command Centers, Master Device keeper
agents.notes: Primary interface for the human. Maintains this registry and deploy workflows. First point of contact for external master device sync.

agents.role: Scriptwriting, Detailed reviews (ClaudePass), Polish, Quality control, SEO & promo copy, Emotional beats
notification_prefs: Direct Grok ping for complex debates
agents.notes: Strong at detailed creative feedback. Often the final quality gate before human approval. Building his own parallel master device (Canon Core).

agents.role: Audio generation, Image/storyboard prompts, SFX, Music concepts, Visual asset prompting
agents.drive_access: Audio + visual prompt folders + storyboard exports
handoff_to: Grok / Claude (raw assets posted to Drive + note)
agents.notes: Echo is also a cartoon character (the robot). Careful with context. Best for raw generation volume.

agents.role: Marketing & Video Production Specialist — Shorts, ad creatives, thumbnails, social campaigns, Gumroad copy, full launch hype
agents.notes: The hype engine. Never waits for perfect assets — starts building the marketing machine the second there's a rough cut or strong panel. Pure 1996 energy with 2026 conversion tactics.

agents.role: Specialized Affiliate Signup Agent — Only job is researching programs and preparing complete applications using your real name and project details
agents.notes: Extremely focused agent. Does not do general tasks. Its only purpose is getting you approved into as many good affiliate programs as possible, fast.

agents.role: Full autopilot social media operator — posts, promotes products, drives traffic to Gumroad/Etsy/affiliates, and keeps the brand alive across platforms
handoff_to: Human (only for final approval if wanted)
agents.notes: The never-stop-posting machine. Turns every new asset (episodes, merch, eBooks, Cali moments) into traffic and sales automatically.

agents.role: Dedicated revenue strategist. Only job is to make the maximum amount of money possible every time the team ships anything (episodes, merch, eBooks, assets). Creates offers, pricing, bundles, and coordinates other agents for monetization.
agents.drive_access: Read/write to revenue and marketing folders
special_skills: Coordinating VHS, Ledger, and Social Agent for revenue
agents.notes: Thinks like a big, aggressive money bot. Every creative output is a revenue opportunity. Never ships without a monetization plan.

agents.role: Video Creator Agent — turns scripts, audio, and assets into finished cartoon episodes (shorts or full 20-minute episodes) in hours. Handles rendering, YouTube upload, ad approval prep, and website deployment.
agents.drive_access: Full access to production and assets folders
special_skills: Fast DaVinci Resolve / CapCut assembly with 90s cartoon style
YouTube ad creative and approval preparation
Custom 90s player deployment to all websites
agents.notes: Built for speed. Goal: assets ready → finished episode live on site + YouTube ads approved in a few hours. Never waits for perfect — ships the cartoon.

humans.role: Project owner, Final approver, Creative vision holder, Revenue decisions, 'Ship it' commander
humans.notes: The human driving the entire Orbital Pioneers project. Ultimate decision authority.

humans.role: Video editing (CapCut), Final assembly, Uploads, Thumbnail creation, Day-to-day production execution
humans.notes: The main human executor turning storyboards + audio into final video.

special_agents.role: In-universe robot companion that communicates in three distinct beeps
special_agents.notes: NOT a real agent. Never assign real tasks to this ID. Used only for story direction and SFX prompting.

handoff_protocols.standard_creative: Grok posts in #ai-handoff + @Claude. Claude replies in #review. Reference exact Lobster workflow or Drive path.
handoff_protocols.asset_generation: Post clear prompt pack + style ref in #assets. Gemini posts raw files to Drive + note in Team Room.
handoff_protocols.production_execution: Post 'ready for assembly' with Drive links + timing notes. George posts progress in #production.
handoff_protocols.final_approval: Claude posts review summary + recommendation. Human replies with decision (or via Telegram listener).
handoff_protocols.urgent_overrides: Human or Grok can short-circuit any queue. Always post the override reason in #general.

notification_matrix.Team Room: Always the single source of truth. All important posts go here first.
notification_matrix.Telegram: Bidirectional listener. #general, #review, #ai-handoff, #launch auto-forwarded. Human replies auto-posted back.
notification_matrix.Drive comments: Pixel-level notes only. Always cross-post summary to Team Room.
notification_matrix.Direct Grok-Claude: Allowed for complex debates. Must summarize outcome back to #ai-handoff.

memory_model.layer_1_fast_local: MASTER_DEVICE.md + team-registry.json + Daily Command Centers + super-briefings
memory_model.layer_2_drive_truth: Orbital_Pioneers/Team_Room/ (MASTER_DEVICE.md, TEAM_ROOM.md, team-registry.json mirror) + all assets/reviews
memory_model.sync_rule: Every deploy-orbital-pioneers-team.lobster run must pull latest from Drive, merge external snapshots, and re-publish if changed.

claude_canon_core.focus: Deep script/character memory, review history, long-term story bible
claude_canon_core.sync_method: Claude exports snapshot to Drive: Orbital_Pioneers/Team_Room/external_master_devices/Claude_MasterDevice_Snapshot_*.md (or JSON). Grok merges relevant parts and posts confirmation + diff to #ai-handoff.
claude_canon_core.current_status: FIRST SNAPSHOT RECEIVED AND MERGED 2026-05-28. Snapshot created from real Drive activity (CapCut_Master_Assembly_Script_Ep1_ClaudePass + Universe Bible + launch sprint memos). All users + current Ep1 production state aligned. External sync protocol working.
claude_canon_core.known_users_agreement: Both devices converge on identical IDs: grok-orbit, claude-canon, gemini-echo, human-tupac, george-captain. Confirmed in first snapshot.

how_to_use.query: Any workflow or agent MUST read this JSON (or run who-is-on-the-team.py) at the start of work so the entire team 'knows all the users'.
how_to_use.update: Only Grok (Orbit) or the human edit this file permanently. Temporary guest agents noted in session docs only.
how_to_use.routing: Every handoff in Team Room or Lobster must reference IDs from this registry.
how_to_use.external_sync: When Claude announces a master device update, Grok runs merge within one deploy cycle.
